$comment: openspec/changes/publiccode-developer-overheid-harvest. The developer.overheid.nl harvest flow on the publiccode schema and the three OpenRegister mappings it runs through. It writes into the Componenten catalogue that publiccode-github-harvest.json seeds. The synchronization the list step names is NOT seeded here: OpenRegister skips an object whose register is missing, so an install without integriq would never get it. PubliccodeHarvestService::setUp(harvest: 'developer-overheid') writes it from lib/Settings/publiccode-developer-overheid-sync.json when an administrator asks. The API key lives on integriq source developer-overheid-oss and never in this app.

x-openregister-flows.name: developer.overheid.nl publiccode harvest
x-openregister-flows.description: Reads every repository with a publiccode.yml in the OSS-register of developer.overheid.nl into the publiccode schema (openspec/changes/publiccode-developer-overheid-harvest). One synchronization pages through GET /repositories?publiccode=true; each repository is classified by the forge its publicCodeUrl points at and the flow fans out into three branches side by side: github.com files from integriq source github-raw, gitlab.com files from gitlab-raw, and every other host from the register's own parse (GET /repositories/{id} on developer-overheid-oss). Filters, not a router, split the branches: a router sends its token down one exit only and the join would wait for the others. Each branch has its own filter, map and write steps and only the end node is shared; it waits for every branch (join), because an end node stops the whole run. A repository the GitHub harvest also finds becomes the same component (same slug rule, upsert patches). Ships disabled; set it up and switch it on in the OpenCatalogi admin settings, section developer.overheid.nl harvest. Needs integriq with its developer-overheid-oss, github-raw and gitlab-raw sources.

publiccode-developer-overheid-locate.name: developer.overheid.nl repository to forge and raw path
publiccode-developer-overheid-locate.description: Classifies one OSS-register repository (at repo) by the forge its publicCodeUrl points at and adds locate.forge (github, gitlab or other), locate.host (lower case, no www.), locate.rawPath (the file's path on integriq source github-raw or gitlab-raw), locate.filePath (the file's path in the repository) and locate.repoKey (the register's own url, normalised as the slug is). The query string and fragment are cut off first. A URL with an empty, "." or ".." segment, on another host, or without a file path is classified other and takes the register's detail endpoint instead. Rules and examples: openspec/changes/publiccode-developer-overheid-harvest/design.md D2. Renders one JSON object so the URL is parsed once.

mapping.locate: {% set u = repo.publicCodeUrl is defined and repo.publicCodeUrl is not iterable ? (repo.publicCodeUrl ~ '')|trim : '' %}{% if '#' in u %}{% set u = u|split('#')|first %}{% endif %}{% if '?' in u %}{% set u = u|split('?')|first %}{% endif %}{% set r = repo.url is defined and repo.url is not iterable ? (repo.url ~ '')|lower|trim : '' %}{% if '#' in r %}{% set r = r|split('#')|first %}{% endif %}{% if '?' in r %}{% set r = r|split('?')|first %}{% endif %}{% set r = r|replace({'https://www.': '', 'http://www.': '', 'https://': '', 'http://': ''})|trim('/') %}{% if r ends with '.git' %}{% set r = r|slice(0, -4) %}{% endif %}{% set forge = 'other' %}{% set host = '' %}{% set rawPath = null %}{% set filePath = null %}{% if u matches '~^https?://~i' %}{% set segs = u|split('://', 2)|last|split('/') %}{% set host = segs|first|lower %}{% if host starts with 'www.' %}{% set host = host|slice(4) %}{% endif %}{% set p = segs|slice(1) %}{% set clean = true %}{% for s in p %}{% if s == '' or s == '.' or s == '..' %}{% set clean = false %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{% if clean and host == 'github.com' and p|length >= 5 and (p[2] == 'blob' or p[2] == 'raw') %}{% set forge = 'github' %}{% set filePath = p|slice(4)|join('/') %}{% set rawPath = '/' ~ p[0] ~ '/' ~ p[1] ~ '/' ~ p[3] ~ '/' ~ filePath %}{% elseif clean and host == 'raw.githubusercontent.com' and p|length >= 4 %}{% if p[2] == 'refs' and (p[3] == 'heads' or p[3] == 'tags') %}{% set filePath = p|slice(5)|join('/') %}{% else %}{% set filePath = p|slice(3)|join('/') %}{% endif %}{% if filePath != '' %}{% set forge = 'github' %}{% set rawPath = '/' ~ p|join('/') %}{% else %}{% set filePath = null %}{% endif %}{% elseif clean and host == 'gitlab.com' %}{% set dash = null %}{% for s in p %}{% if s == '-' and dash is null %}{% set dash = loop.index0 %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{% if dash is not null and dash >= 2 and p|length >= dash + 4 and (p[dash + 1] == 'blob' or p[dash + 1] == 'raw') %}{% set forge = 'gitlab' %}{% set filePath = p|slice(dash + 3)|join('/') %}{% set rawPath = '/' ~ p|slice(0, dash)|join('/') ~ '/-/raw/' ~ p[dash + 2] ~ '/' ~ filePath %}{% endif %}{% endif %}{% endif %}{% if host == '' %}{% set host = r|split('/')|first %}{% endif %}{{ {forge: forge, host: host, rawPath: rawPath, filePath: filePath, repoKey: r}|json_encode }}

publiccode-developer-overheid-detail.name: developer.overheid.nl repository detail to publiccode
publiccode-developer-overheid-detail.description: Lifts the register's own parse of the publiccode.yml (detail.body.publicCode, from GET /repositories/{id}) to publiccode.body, where a file fetched from a forge sits, so the filter and the repository mapping read both the same way. Used only for a repository on a host without a raw-file source. When the detail call failed there is nothing to lift, and the cast removes the unresolved path rather than writing it as text, so the filter drops the item.

publiccode-developer-overheid-repository.name: developer.overheid.nl repository with its publiccode.yml to publiccode
publiccode-developer-overheid-repository.description: Turns one OSS-register repository (at repo, classified at locate) with its publiccode.yml (at publiccode.body) into a publiccode object under `component`. Every publiccode field is shaped exactly as mapping publiccode-github-hit shapes it, and the slug follows the same rule over the url the file declares, plus the file's directory when the file sits below the root of the repository the register lists. A repository both harvests find is therefore one object; the upsert patches, so a field one harvest does not write survives the other. Change the slug rule in both mappings together. harvestedFrom is the host the file came from. rawPubliccode is written only for a file fetched from github.com or gitlab.com: the register's parse is not the file. developerOverheid records how the register lists the repository. openspec/changes/publiccode-developer-overheid-harvest/design.md D5.

mapping.component.slug: {% set u = publiccode.body.url is defined and publiccode.body.url is not iterable ? (publiccode.body.url ~ '')|lower|trim : '' %}{% if '#' in u %}{% set u = u|split('#')|first %}{% endif %}{% if '?' in u %}{% set u = u|split('?')|first %}{% endif %}{% set u = u|replace({'https://www.': '', 'http://www.': '', 'https://': '', 'http://': ''})|trim('/') %}{% if u ends with '.git' %}{% set u = u|slice(0, -4) %}{% endif %}{% set fp = locate.filePath is defined and locate.filePath is not iterable ? (locate.filePath ~ '')|lower : '' %}{% if u != '' and u == (locate.repoKey ~ '') and '/' in fp %}{% set u = u ~ '/' ~ fp|split('/')|slice(0, -1)|join('/') %}{% endif %}{{ u|replace({'/': '-', '.': '-', '_': '-', ' ': '-', ':': '-', '~': '-'}) }}
